supersedes: legacy runtime commerce/contribution/extraction values where they conflict with this contract

a07_boundary.principle: AI may offer/decline trade conversationally; motor must own stock, price, gates, inventory, stones, persistence and transaction results.
a07_boundary.return_requirement: Return to existing safe conversation/session without re-entering cmd_hablar() or retriggering canonical mission handling.

contribution_working_curve.rule: Institutional item threshold equals the working cumulative Contribution reachable at its catalog source_mission. Contribution is checked, never decremented.

pricing_method.public_items: Preserve existing stone prices where already catalogued.
pricing_method.institutional_items_with_existing_stone_: Preserve existing stone price after reclassification.
pricing_method.institutional_items_without_stone_price: Assign within stage band by relative power_budget rank among institutional items lacking a stone price.
pricing_method.purpose: Contribution controls access; stones preserve economic opportunity cost and prevent unlocked institutional stock from becoming free.
classification_priority: existing local public permission HUESPED_SAUCES -> PUBLIC_CONTEXTUAL_STONES
any existing sect/institutional permission -> INSTITUTIONAL_STONES_GATE regardless of historical currency field

Botica/specialist; exact seller to Astra audit
permission/reputation may gate; not unlimited routine stock
medical authorization; not unlimited routine stock

consumables.rule: Buying finished medicines must never replace Alchemy mastery or renewable ingredient loops.

institutional_with_authorization: Authorized sect manual copies explicitly tied to existing technique/permission sources
no_sale: ZhuJi-restricted texts unless a later explicit commerce authority exists
manuals.reason: Current technique catalog does not carry a complete authoritative commerce/source map for every manual.

extraction_and_herboristery.note: Do not create kill/extract/sell-all economy in Arc1.

trade_roles.rule: A material can have multiple sinks; its best functional value should generally exceed its liquid resale value.

material_exchange_policy.principle: Monster automatic drops and Spiritual Extraction materials are functional currencies-in-kind for workshop services, not merely resale junk.
material_exchange_policy.public_item_rule: Public equipment may keep a full-stone route and also expose a material-service route with a substantially reduced stone service fee.
material_exchange_policy.institutional_item_rule: Institutional equipment keeps Contribution/permission/mission as access gates, but the player may satisfy the economic cost either with the full stone price or with the approved material bundle plus a reduced stone service fee. Contribution is never spent.
material_exchange_policy.extraction_rule: Extraction materials represent the specialized component; automatic drops represent the superficial/structural component. Where both are listed, both are required.

routes.note: Material-service-only identity item. No pure-stone substitute.
Institutional gate preserved on material route; Contribution is checked but never spent.

material_exchange_policy.economic_target: Material route should normally save roughly 50-70% of the stone outlay while still costing time/field effort. It must never remove existing mission/permission/Contribution gates.

coverage_target.note: No material routes in LI; the profession/tutorial economy is kept simple there. Material services become a meaningful alternative from LII onward.

material_buyback_policy.principle: Liquidating materials is deliberately less valuable than using them in workshop services, Alchemy or requisitions.
rules: Bulk sale consumes only complete lots; remainder stays in inventory.
Workshop/requisition/Alchemy sinks should normally beat liquidation value.
Mutant x1.5 affects automatic-loot quantity after success; it does not increase buyback price.
Extraction is not affected by Mutant loot multiplier.

extraction_authority.rule: These redesign values replace ver76 legacy 75/60/40/25 and legacy quantity=1 where conflicting.

forbidden_runtime_semantics: treat current spendable balance as final institutional-progress authority
contribution.migration_note: No player-save migration is required because the game has never entered production. Development saves using spendable Contribution may be invalidated/reset. Runtime must adopt only the new non-spendable cumulative semantics.

legacy_replacement.rule: All conflicting Arc1 legacy commerce/equipment/items/contribution/extraction semantics must disappear from the target runtime. Do not preserve aliases, migration shims, dual catalogs, legacy save compatibility, legacy commands or fallback behavior.

dialogue_entry.required_flow: HABLAR -> natural dialogue option -> Commerce UI/domain -> close -> safe return to same conversation
player_options: Tengo algunas cosas que quizá te interesen.
dialogue_entry.note: Exact natural phrase can vary by NPC/voice. The economic operation remains motor-owned and deterministic.

implementation_sequence.rule: Do not integrate full catalog first. Validate a minimal merchant slice before expansion.

final_runtime_must_not_contain: legacy Contribution decrement paths used as active authority
legacy equipment catalog entries conflicting with the 68-item Arc1 catalog
legacy monster automatic loot tables conflicting with approved low-drop tables
legacy public BUY/SELL/COMMERCE parser command authority
legacy item aliases kept for save compatibility
parallel old/new catalogs or fallback branches
legacy_policy.historical_artifacts: May remain only in docs/experimentos/backup or audit history; never imported/executed by runtime.

blockers: purge legacy runtime semantics and ensure no old/new coexistence
safe dialogue -> commerce entrypoint and safe return
new ITEMS/material definitions replacing legacy without coexistence
merchant capability registry based only on canonical evidence/human approval

merchant_capability_authority.rule: NPC role alone never grants commerce. Only explicit capabilities in the merchant registry may expose SELL/BUY/SERVICE/AUTHORIZE/FULFILL/INFORMATION_ROUTING.
merchant_capability_authority.pilot: ning_cai -> SELL + FULFILL -> calzas_sendero_pinos -> 8 stones -> ROUTINE_UNLIMITED -> 0 commerce turns

transaction_engine_authority.pipeline: EVALUATE -> CONFIRM -> REVALIDATE -> BUILD_DELTA -> COMMIT -> RECEIPT

catalog_ui_authority.rule: Use a text/list catalog in the existing MUD style; recover the prior user experience but never legacy implementation.
